protocol.pools: Primary exact timestamp-aligned raw quotes; separate secondary mixed recorded-price pool adding historical FT rows. Secondary legacy quotes have unknown quote timestamps and cannot validate exact-provider execution.
protocol.source: Every saved manual, primary, experimental and live-lab snapshot plus original historical FT records; every valid original exact over quote is extracted before rule search.
protocol.unit: One first qualifying priced point per event and rule; all observations of an event stay in one temporal cohort. Unquoted observations receive no invented ROI.
protocol.purge: Remove events spanning a discovery/validation/test boundary. Discovery and validation labels must have been confirmed before the subsequent cohort began.
protocol.features: Clock, score, line, price, overround, cumulative measured stats, validated complete fresh windows and original goal-profile fields; missing is unknown, never zero.
protocol.cut_learning: Discovery-only first priced observation per match, not repeated-point quantiles. No threshold is fitted on validation or test results.
protocol.search: All one- and two-feature conjunctions of the learned numeric cuts and observed categorical levels; no old pocket conditions or names are supplied.
protocol.shortlist_rank: Discovery-only one-sided iid lower mean bound, with positive raw and leave-best-day and leave-best-league returns; at least three discovery days. This is screening, not a statistical claim.
protocol.test: Evaluate every frozen shortlisted rule; Holm correction across that whole list. Never substitute a different rule after seeing test results.
protocol.research_survivor: Positive validation and test ROI and leave-top3/day/league ROI, adequate phase support and positive full mature ROI; statistical status is disclosed separately.
protocol.walk_forward: For each next day learn cuts and rank rules using only earlier original points and labels confirmed before that day; take the first three discovery-ranked rules, deduplicate matches, and retain every losing or empty day. This is a separate predeclared research-policy simulation.
protocol.confirmation_limit: All history has previously been inspected in some form. These temporal tests are reconstructed out-of-time checks, not a newly untouched confirmatory holdout. Execution at the provider price is not established.

test.best_league: Brazil Copa Atlantico U19 - 80 mins play

limitations: No existing pocket catalog or chosen entry ledger was used to define the search universe.
Raw snapshot observations are a sampled provider universe; unobserved matches and unavailable prices cannot be restored.
Temporal cohorts are purged by event and training labels require recorded confirmation before the next cohort.
Previously inspected history is not a new untouched confirmatory test, even when this search is newly rebuilt.
The walk-forward replay is an idealized paper policy on original provider quotes; user execution and manual invocation times are unknown.
Three validation/test days give few independent clusters; lack of evidence is not proof of negative true expectation.
